design: Additive retrospective source-grounded postcondition facet, frozen before reading target comment bodies. Strict v1 sample effects and v2 exact CLI/trigger-target acceptance remain unchanged.

source.basis: The deterministic command specifies a literal comment message; the handler transforms user content with optional headers, tracking metadata and footers before native issues.createComment. Thus exact whole-body equality is a separate stricter facet.

goal: Measure the independently observable partial postcondition that the source-defined smoke test message was persisted as native PR comment content.
eligiblePopulation: Selected original public github/gh-aw PR comment identities, discovered from the selected smoke-ci run's retained output graph. Partial population only; no complete workflow-run or PR cohort claim.
predicate: A verified native PR identity belongs to repositoryId1036865607; its native comment has a stable ID and matching issue_url/html_url; body contains exactly one complete line equal to the source command's literal message with the selected original run ID substituted; created_at equals updated_at and is before the frozen cutoff and no earlier than the selected run creation. The native creation timestamp assigns the period.
expectedMessageLine: ✅ smoke-ci: safeoutputs CLI comment + comment-memory run (RUN_ID)
historicalCustody: The current API snapshot is not backdated wholesale. Only an unchanged native comment with equal creation/update timestamps can establish this creation-time content facet; edited comments, current PR state, labels, footers and current issue bodies cannot reconstruct historical acceptance.
deduplication: Count each repository-native comment node ID once, regardless of repeated acquisition, run references or observation requests.
measurement: Native creation events in inclusive-start/exclusive-end disjoint daily periods. Other periods remain missing, never zero.
strictAcceptance: Does not prove this was the triggering PR, which workflow revision executed, original CLI request validity, protected processing success, hide-older semantics, comment-memory or cross-run restoration. Those remain null unless separately proven.
contribution: Literal run ID plus matching timing is corroboration only; it is not a protected creation receipt, sole causation, or verified workflow contribution. Any actor establishing the same native postcondition is counted.
